name: Sands of Deception
source:
In a desert kingdom where gods walk among mortals, Prince Shiva—rumored to possess divine powers—faces an unknown threat to his life. To protect himself, he selects three exceptional warriors from Shakti College, the top war college of the realm, including you, a daring recruit with a hidden strength.

But as loyalties are tested and secrets begin to unravel like the shifting sands in a desert storm, you discover that Shiva’s greatest enemy might not reside outside the palace walls like you initially thought. Will you uncover the truth, protect the prince, and find love among gods and mortals, or will the sands of destiny bury you all?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.indiemyth]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
在诸神行走于凡人之间的沙漠王国中，传闻拥有神力的湿婆王子面临着未知的生命威胁。为了保护自己，他从王国顶级战争学院夏克提学院中挑选了三名优秀的战士，其中包括你这个有着隐藏力量的大胆新兵。

但随着忠诚度受到考验，秘密开始像沙漠风暴中的流沙一样被揭开，你会发现湿婆最大的敌人可能并不像你最初想象的那样住在宫殿墙外。你会揭开真相，保护王子，并在神与凡之间找到爱情，还是命运之沙将你们全部埋葬？

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.indiemyth]Google Play[/url]]
